concerns.text: FR-001 references “(See US-1)” but no identifier US-1 is defined anywhere in the document. The user stories are titled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc., without corresponding US‑1, US‑2 IDs.

Inconsistent terminology: the specification uses both “User Story 1” (plain text) and the shorthand “US-1” in cross‑references. This creates ambiguity and breaks traceability between requirements and stories.
